messages:
incident-bot: SEV2 auto-detect: cont-batch queue anomaly in us-east-1 for model rwd-open-7b-quant. 5xx spike ~12% over 4m, cont_batch.queue_depth > 9k, kvcache.insert_rate and eviction_rate rising rapidly. Auto-pager to oncall.

oncall-Alex: acknowledged. SRE + runtime, please triage. Any immediate hypotheses?

sre-Jamie: looking now. Observed contiguous rise in queue depth over 7 minutes, microbatch_size drifting up, and prefetch QPS roughly x3 vs baseline. A few worker pods restarted with OOMs. Last deploy window ~55m ago.

eng-runtime-Lee: joining thread. Noticed PR #2124 (prefetch coalescing) merged ~1h ago as well. Prefetch fanout appears higher for long-prefix requests. Also cont_batch.max_window_ms is 40ms cluster-wide, which could be aggregating more tokens at high concurrency.

oncall-Alex: what are customers seeing? any tickets?

support-Rahul: CS-3391 from BlueSkyOps reporting large batch jobs failing with timeouts and increased 502s. Multiple tenants with bursty traffic show p99 regressions. No evidence of data exposure.

pm-Sara: Im notifying account teams and preparing a brief for impacted customers. Objective: stabilize first, then root cause.

eng-runtime-Lee: low-risk mitigation options:
- lower cont_batch.max_window_ms 40 -> 10ms to reduce microbatching
- introduce infra toggle prefetch.max_inflight=120
- soft-route noisy tenants to rwd-open-7b-quant-slim variant
- if needed, revert PR #2124

oncall-Alex: can we apply the first two quickly? prefer config toggles before a code rollback.

eng-runtime-Lee: yes. I'll apply infra toggle + routing immediately. Jamie, can you canary the window change?

sre-Jamie: will canary cont_batch.max_window_ms=10ms on 8% of nodes now. Also set a temporary alert on node.oom_count to 1 within 5m.

eng-runtime-Lee: applying infra toggle: 
```bash
curl -XPOST https://infra-api.internal/configs -d '{"key":"prefetch.max_inflight","value":"120"}'
```
-> 200 OK. Dashboard shows prefetch QPS declining.

sre-Jamie: canary results after 2 minutes: canary nodes queue_depth down ~62%, microbatch median size halved, p99 latency dropped from 3.6s -> 0.9s in canary.

oncall-Alex: push routing for BlueSkyOps?

eng-runtime-Lee: routing rule pushed: tenant=blueskyops -> prefer_variant=rwd-open-7b-quant-slim. Verified via routing API.

incident-bot: Reminder: escalation window 30m. Current severity: Sev2.

support-Rahul: BlueSkyOps CS updated. They've resumed some workflows and see improved success rates on retries, but large bulk uploads still occasionally hit timeouts.

pm-Sara: immediate action items: (1) keep toggles for 90m while monitoring, (2) open revert PR for prefetch coalescing, (3) assign postmortem.

eng-runtime-Lee: diagnostic note: kvcache TTL behavior: under pressure TTLs are not truncating; prefetcher isn't honoring the cache backpressure signal, causing duplicate inflight fetches. Need counters for prefetch.dedupe_miss and kvcache.backpressure_signals.

sre-Jamie: monitoring checklist: cont_batch.queue_depth, cont_batch.microbatch_size, prefetch.qps, kvcache.eviction_rate, node.oom_count. Ill post 5-min cadence updates.

oncall-Alex: leaving a short runbook for night team: if cluster queue_depth > 7k for 10m -> reduce prefetch.max_inflight to 60 and expand routing to top-10 noisy tenants; if node.oom_count spikes to >3% of pool, escalate and consider rollback of PR #2124.

eng-runtime-Lee: command snippets for night:
```
# lower prefetch inflight
curl -XPOST https://infra-api.internal/configs -d '{"key":"prefetch.max_inflight","value":"60"}'
# set cont_batch window globally
curl -XPOST https://infra-api.internal/configs -d '{"key":"cont_batch.max_window_ms","value":"10"}'
# route noisy tenant
curl -XPOST https://routing-api.internal/rules -d '{"tenant":"<tenant>","prefer_variant":"rwd-open-7b-quant-slim"}'
```

support-Rahul: attaching BlueSkyOps logs to CS-3391 and flagging impacted request ids for eng investigation.

pm-Sara: assigning postmortem to eng-runtime-Lee and sre-Jamie. Include timeline, config diffs, PRs, customer impact table, and proposed long-term fixes (prefetch backpressure handshake + adaptive batching logic).

oncall-Alex: cluster summary before handoff: cluster p99 ~1.1s, error rate ~1.5%. Handoff to night-oncall in 50m. Keep this thread active for updates and runbook execution. :white_check_mark:
